#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int ans = 0;
    int n = s.length();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < n && s[i] == s[j]) {
            j++;
        }
        int len = j - i;
        ans += (len % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
